title: Cobra Mk IV (Elite Dangerous)
intro: The Cobra Mk IV by Faulcon DeLacy is a heavier relative of the Cobra Mk III with one more small hardpoint, and it is not available to every player. Its cockpit has the pilot seat and one multicrew seat. It uses the shared cockpit system and HOTAS layout.

panels.name: Cobra Mk IV: seats and hardpoints
panels.text: Facts about the Cobra Mk IV that set it apart from the other ships: its seats, its weapon mounts and the landing pad size it needs.
panels.context: Everything else in the Cobra Mk IV's cockpit works like in every other Elite Dangerous ship.

controls.name: Pilot seat (helm)
controls.text: The pilot's seat of the Cobra Mk IV, the helm. Whoever sits here flies the ship and has the whole HOTAS layout of this guide.
controls.context: The Cobra Mk IV takes up to two people in all; the other seats are for crew who join in multicrew.

controls.name: Multicrew seats
controls.text: The extra seats of the Cobra Mk IV, for up to two crew in all. A friend who joins can sit here as gunner, or as fighter controller when the ship carries a fighter.
controls.context: A gunner works the turreted weapons while the pilot flies; the roles are chosen on the role panel.

controls.name: Hardpoints (weapon mounts)
controls.text: The weapon mounts of the Cobra Mk IV: two medium and three small hardpoints. Bigger mounts take bigger, stronger weapons.
controls.context: The pilot puts the Cobra Mk IV's weapons into fire groups on the right panel and fires them with the trigger and the weapon release button.

controls.name: Landing pad size
controls.text: The Cobra Mk IV needs a small landing pad or a bigger one. Stations have small, medium and large pads, and small outposts may not have the bigger ones.
controls.context: When the pilot asks a station for docking, the station gives a pad that fits the ship's size.
